podcast.body: This solo hit was self-penned and self-produced, featuring a retro sound that paid homage to Rockabilly. It topped the Hot 100 for a month, spanning the end of 1987 and the beginning of 1988. Its iconic music video, showcasing George Michael in a leather jacket, tight jeans, and facial stubble, redefined his image for the decade. "Faith's month at number one spanned the end of 1987 and the start of 88. And it was the first of four number ones from the Faith LP, also the top album of 88."
